title: Kong DB-less smoke: strip_path with a service path, pass-through path, method and host scoping
claims: route /api (strip_path: true) on a service with path /inner forwards /api/x?q=1 to backend a as /inner/x?q=1
route /raw (strip_path: false) forwards /raw/z?k=v to backend b unchanged
a method outside the route's methods list is not forwarded
a request for another Host is not forwarded
an unrouted path is not forwarded
not_claimed: Kong string-prefix matching of /apix (Ferrum matches by path segment and answers 404, which is stricter)
the exact forwarded path for a request to the bare /api prefix

source_semantics: Kong 3.x traditional router: paths are prefixes; with strip_path true the matched prefix is removed and the remainder is appended to the service path; with strip_path false the request path is appended unchanged; methods and hosts restrict the route; no match answers 404.
